short_description.text: Rachel — daughter of Laban (GEN 29:10) and wife of Jacob (GEN 29:28).
Pharaoh — Pharaoh during Israel's Exodus from Egypt (EXO 3:10).
King of Moab — former King of Moab from whom Sihon had taken land (NUM 21:26). Of the tribe of Moabite.
Sisera — commander of Jabin's army (JDG 4:2).
Barak — summoned by Deborah (JDG 4:6) to defeat Jabin's army (JDG 4:15).
Gideon — son of Joash (JDG 6:11) who torn down the altar to Baal (JDG 6:25). Of the tribe of Manasseh.
Jephthah — a valiant warrior (JDG 11:1).
Hannah — wife of Elkanah (1SA 1:2), mother of Samuel (1SA 1:20).
Peninnah — wife of Elkanah (1SA 1:2).
Hophni — son of Eli (1SA 1:3), a corrupt priest (1SA 2:12). Of the tribe of Levi.
Phinehas — son of Eli (1SA 1:3), a corrupt priest (1SA 2:12). Of the tribe of Levi.
Ichabod — Phinehas's son (1SA 4:21), Eli's grandson. Of the tribe of Levi.
Joshua — the Beth-shemite (1SA 6:14).
Eleazar — consecrated to keep the ark in Kiriath-jearim (1SA 7:1).
Abiel — (grand?)father of Kish (1SA 9:1), (great?) grandfather of King Saul. Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Zeror — father of Abiel (1SA 9:1), ancestor of King Saul. Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Becorath — father of Zeror (1SA 9:1), ancestor of King Saul. Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Aphiah — father of Becorath (1SA 9:1), ancestor of King Saul. Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Ahitub — son of Phinehas, grandson of Eli, and father of Ahijah (1SA 14:3). Of the tribe of Levi.
Merab — daughter of Saul (1SA 14:49). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Ahinoam — wife of Saul (1SA 14:50).
Ahimaaz — father of Ahinoam (1SA 14:50).
Agag — king of the Amalekites (1SA 15:8).
Adriel — the Meholathite (1SA 18:19).
Ahimelech — the priest of Nob (1SA 21:1). Of the tribe of Levi.
Doeg — the Edomite (1SA 21:7).
King of Moab — King of Moab to whom David took his parents (1SA 22:3).
Nabal — the rich man of Maon, husband of Abigail (1SA 25:3). Of the tribe of Judah.
Palti — Michal's new husband (1SA 25:44).
Laish — from Gallim (1SA 25:44).
Ahimelech — the Hittite (1SA 26:6).
In Sharon.
